title: Cities Skylines | Franklin, Episode 2: New Norway
coverage: One first available frame in every 5-second bin, plus frames with FFmpeg scene score > 0.30. Scene scores are computed at 480px width. This is sparse visual evidence, not exhaustive gag coverage: brief overlays, gradual changes, and gags between samples can be missed. Read source video around relevant moments and use still for precise timestamp rereads.

sampling.regularRule: first available frame in each 5-second bin
sampling.timestampOrigin: first source video frame = 0; actual selected PTS, not idealized sample times
